semantics: Explicit #undef removes each tested builtin; later definitions override it.
Direct expression occurrence creates an INLINED CALL with expansion BLOCK and LITERAL. Builtin synthetic METHOD CODE is present and empty; it is not an absent CODE property.
Direct builtin method identity is source-file-qualified, e.g. main.c:__STDC__:int(0), with literal type int for1 and longint for199901L. Explicit redefinitions use actual #define text as METHOD CODE.
Inside a user macro, builtin tokens fully expand to literals inside that user macro expansion; no separate builtin wrapper/method is emitted for those nested tokens.

A zconf-like config deriving STDC from __STDC__ disables fallback reserve/release prototypes, leaving CALL typeANY. A header with STDC undefined or derived only from absent __GNUC__ enables the prototypes and yields void*/void.
scope: All selected AST/NODES/EDGES/FLOWS records and separators retained; additional LOC metadata preserved in raw output. No producer/reference bytes were edited and no root source was modified. v1 comparisons are diagnostics, not acceptance of the new default implementation. Standard-context absence here does not claim all GNU/CDT builtin parity.
